summary: IgnitionSense is a simple, interactive web dashboard that helps astronauts and mission controllers check for fire risks in space. Fire behaves differently in zero gravity it burns as a round sphere and is very hard to see. Our app works completely offline without needing the internet, which is perfect for deep space travel. By moving sliders for oxygen, gravity, and materials, users get an instant fire danger score to help keep space habitats safe.
details:
IgnitionSense AI takes complicated data about space fires and turns it into a simple safety index. It lets astronauts monitor fire danger based on changes in oxygen levels, different gravity types (like Moon or Mars), and the types of materials inside the spacecraft. The app is built using Python and Streamlit. Users can select the cabin oxygen percentage, the gravity environment, and the material type. The code then uses simple math rules to calculate a Fire Hazard Score from 0 to 100 and displays an automatic safety warning. It helps astronauts make fast safety decisions on their own. Because the app works completely offline, it does not need a connection to Earth. This is very important because space communications have long time delays when traveling to Mars or the Moon. We used the Python language and the Streamlit library to build the website quickly. We used Pandas to load and show a small sample table of data, and we saved all our files on GitHub.
